title: Adva Network Security extends Security Director with automated crypto management for FSP 3000 S-Flex™ and CryptoMux™
summary: Adva Network Security, an Adtran company, today announced that its Security Director platform now supports the FSP 3000 400Gbit/s S-Flex™ and 200Gbit/s CryptoMux™ encrypted optical transport solutions ...
body_markdown:
News summary:


- Diverse technologies and increasing compliance requirements complicate unified security management
- Security Director automates crypto management and simplifies security operations across FSP 3000 S-Flex™ and CryptoMux™ deployments
- Security Compliance Score provides clear visibility into network security and compliance status


Adva Network Security, an Adtran company, today announced that its Security Director platform now supports the FSP 3000 400Gbit/s S-Flex™ and 200Gbit/s CryptoMux™ encrypted optical transport solutions, in addition to its metro Ethernet portfolio. Security Director automates the setup of encrypted end-to-end connections, simplifies recurring operational tasks and monitors compliance with defined security policies. This accelerates commissioning, reduces the risk of manual configuration errors and supports secure and traceable network operations.
